```         
qiime feature-table merge \
  --i-tables ../Allozithro2017/PhylogeneticTree/tree-table.qza ../Liu2017/PhylogeneticTree/final-tree-table.qza ../Fujimoto2024/PhylogeneticTree/tree-table.qza\
  --o-merged-table merged-table.qza

qiime feature-table merge-seqs \
  --i-data ../Allozithro2017/PhylogeneticTree/final-tree-seqs.qza ../Liu2017/PhylogeneticTree/final-tree-seqs.qza ../Fujimoto2024/PhylogeneticTree/final-tree-seqs.qza\
  --o-merged-data merged-seqs.qza
```

```         
qiime phylogeny filter-tree \
  --i-tree ../Greengenes2/2024.09.phylogeny.asv.nwk.qza \
  --i-table merged-table.qza \
  --o-filtered-tree greengenes2-merged-tree.qza
```

```         
qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn \
  --i-classifier ../Greengenes2/2024.09.backbone.full-length.nb.sklearn-1.4.2.qza\
  --i-reads merged-seqs.qza \
  --p-confidence 0.9 \
  --o-classification greengenes2_merged_taxonomy.qza
```

```         
qiime taxa barplot \
  --i-table merged-table.qza \
  --i-taxonomy greengenes2_merged_taxonomy.qza \
  --m-metadata-file ../merged_metadata.tsv\
  --o-visualization merged-taxa-bar-plots.qzv
```

## Taxonomy

```{r}
# Taxonomy matrix
parse_taxonomy <- function(tax_df) {
  # tax_df expected to have columns: Feature.ID (or similar) and Taxon (string "k__; p__; ...")
  cnames <- colnames(tax_df)
  idcol <- cnames[1]    # usually "Feature.ID"
  taxcol <- cnames[2]   # usually "Taxon"
  tax_df2 <- as.data.frame(tax_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(tax_df2)[1:2] <- c("FeatureID","Taxon")
  tax_df2$Taxon <- as.character(tax_df2$Taxon)
  ranks <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")
  tax_sep <- tidyr::separate(tax_df2, Taxon, into = ranks, sep = ";\\s*", fill = "right", remove = FALSE)
  clean_rank <- function(x) {
    x <- ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "" , NA, x)
    x <- gsub("^[dkpcofgs]__|^__", "", x)   # remove prefixes like 'k__'
    trimws(x)
  }
  tax_mat <- tax_sep %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(ranks)) %>%
    mutate_all(clean_rank) %>%
    as.matrix()
  rownames(tax_mat) <- tax_sep$FeatureID
  tax_mat
}

tax_mat <- parse_taxonomy(tax_q)
tax_mat <- tax_table(tax_mat)
```

## Functions for annotating

```{r}
get_combinations <- function(vec) {
  # We want combinations of size 2 up to the full length of the vector
  n <- length(vec)
  
  # If there are fewer than 2 elements, there are no "combinations" to return
  if (n < 2) return(character(0))
  
  # Iterate through each combination size (k) from 2 to n
  res <- lapply(2:n, function(k) {
    # combn generates a matrix where each column is a unique combination
    combs_matrix <- combn(vec, k)
    
    # Collapse each column into a single string using "_"
    apply(combs_matrix, 2, paste, collapse = "_")
  })
  
  # Flatten the list of vectors into a single character vector
  unlist(c(vec,res))
  

}

get_combinations(c("Allo", "Fuji", "Liu"))
```

```{r}


just_colors <- c(
  "#FFFF00",
  "#56B4E9",
  "#76EE00",
  "darkgoldenrod",
  "darkolivegreen",
  "darkslategray4",
  "black"
)

cohort_colors <- just_colors
names(cohort_colors)<- c("Allozithro",
                         "Fujimoto",
                         "Liu",
                         "Allozithro_Fujimoto",
                         "Allozithro_Liu",
                         "Fujimoto_Liu",
                         "Allozithro_Fujimoto_Liu")

colors_cohort <- unlist(lapply(names(cohort_colors), FUN = function(x) gsub("_", " & ", x)))
names(colors_cohort)<- just_colors


asv_mapping_func <- function(phylo_obj,
                             save = TRUE,
                             save_file_name = "Allo_Liu_ASVs.txt",
                             id_col_name = "SampleID",
                             cohort_col_name = "Project",
save_path = "/Users/sophiehuebler/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/MergedTree/TreeColors",
custom_color_map = data.frame(
  Cohort = c("Allo", "Fuji", "Liu", "Allo_Fuji", "Allo_Liu", "Fuji_Liu", "Allo_Fuji_Liu"),
  Color = just_colors
  )) {
  
  # Extract OTUs
  if(taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj@otu_table)){
    otus <- as.data.frame(t(phylo_obj@otu_table))
    otus[,id_col_name] <- colnames(phylo_obj@otu_table)
  } else {
    otus <- as.data.frame(phylo_obj@otu_table) 
    otus[,id_col_name] <- rownames(phylo_obj@otu_table)
  }
  
  # Extract Metadata
  metas <- as.data.frame(unclass(phylo_obj@sam_data))
  metas[,id_col_name] <- rownames(phylo_obj@sam_data)
  metas <- metas[, c(id_col_name, cohort_col_name)]
  
  # Pivot and identify presence/absence
  df <- otus %>%
    left_join(metas, by = id_col_name) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -all_of(c(id_col_name, cohort_col_name)),
      names_to = "ASV_ID",
      values_to = "Count"
    ) %>%
    filter(Count > 0) %>%
    distinct(ASV_ID, !!sym(cohort_col_name)) %>%
    arrange(!!sym(cohort_col_name)) %>%
    mutate(exists = 1) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(cohort_col_name), 
      values_from = exists, 
      values_fill = 0 
    ) 
  
  cohort_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), "ASV_ID")
  
  # Map overlaps and join with colors
  df_final <- df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract column names where the value is 1, sort alphabetically, and combine with "_"
      Cohort = paste(sort(cohort_cols[c_across(all_of(cohort_cols)) == 1]), collapse = "_")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(ASV_ID, Cohort) %>%
    left_join(custom_color_map, by = "Cohort")
  
  # Save to iTOL format
  if(save){
    color_mapping <- df_final %>%
      mutate(
        Type = "label",
        Style = "bold"
      )
    
    itol_data <- paste(color_mapping$ASV_ID, color_mapping$Type, color_mapping$Color, color_mapping$Style, sep = ",")
    
    writeLines(
      c("TREE_COLORS", "SEPARATOR COMMA", "DATA", itol_data), 
      paste0(save_path, "/", save_file_name)
    )
  }
  
  return(df_final)
}
```

# Tree (Collapsing)

```{r}
vizualize_collapse <- function(phylo_obj, tax_level){
  
  ps_temp  <- suppressMessages(tax_glom(phylo_obj, taxrank = tax_level))
  ps_temp <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_temp)>0, ps_temp)
  
  print(ps_temp)
  
  merge_colors <- asv_mapping_func(ps_temp,
                             save = FALSE,
           save_file_name = "Allo_Liu_Fuji_genus.txt",
           id_col_name = "sample.id",
           cohort_col_name = "study",
           save_path = "/Users/sophiehuebler/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/MergedTree/TreeColors")
  
  print(table(merge_colors$Cohort))
  
  tax <- tax_table(ps_temp)%>%
    as.data.frame()%>%
    rownames_to_column("ASV_ID")
  
  tax2 <- merge_colors %>%
  left_join(tax %>%
              select(ASV_ID, !!ensym(tax_level)),
            by = "ASV_ID")
  
  ggtree(phy_tree(ps_temp), 
         layout = "circular", 
         branch.length = "none") %<+%   
    tax2 +
  geom_tippoint( size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9, aes(color = Color))+
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = !!ensym(tax_level), color = Color),
              offset = 1, size = 2)+
  #scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "legend",
                       name = "Cohort",
                       breaks = names(colors_cohort),
                       labels = unname(colors_cohort))+
  ggtitle(paste0(tax_level, " Level"))

}
```

```{r}
## 1) Build the matrix in the orientation ComBat_seq expects:
##    rows = taxa/features, cols = samples
count_matrix <- as(otu_table(ps_filtered), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_filtered)) {
  count_matrix <- t(count_matrix)
}

## 2) Align metadata to the count matrix columns
count_meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_filtered))
count_meta <- count_meta[colnames(count_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

batch_var <- droplevels(factor(count_meta$study))

## If agvhd is categorical, use group
bio_var <- droplevels(factor(count_meta$agvhd))

## 3) Sanity checks
stopifnot(ncol(count_matrix) == nrow(count_meta))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_matrix), rownames(count_meta)))
stopifnot(all(count_matrix >= 0))
stopifnot(all(count_matrix == round(count_matrix)))   # raw counts

## Original sample library sizes
summary(colSums(count_matrix))
which(colSums(count_matrix) == 0)
```

```{r}
## 4) Reproduce ComBat_seq's internal filtering:
## keep taxa that are NON-zero in at least one sample of EVERY batch
keep <- Reduce("&", lapply(levels(batch_var), function(b) {
  rowSums(count_matrix[, batch_var == b, drop = FALSE]) > 0
}))

sum(keep)  # how many taxa survive?

count_matrix_keep <- count_matrix[keep, , drop = FALSE]

## These are the "library sizes" edgeR sees after ComBat_seq filtering
summary(colSums(count_matrix_keep))
bad_samples <- colnames(count_matrix_keep)[colSums(count_matrix_keep) == 0]
bad_samples
```

```{r}
sample_keep <- colSums(count_matrix_keep) > 0

count_matrix_cb <- count_matrix_keep[, sample_keep, drop = FALSE]
batch_var_cb <- droplevels(batch_var[sample_keep])
bio_var_cb   <- droplevels(bio_var[sample_keep])

adjusted_counts <- sva::ComBat_seq(
  counts = count_matrix_cb,
  batch  = batch_var_cb,
  group  = bio_var_cb
)
```

```{r}

ps_corrected <- prune_samples(!(sample_data(ps_filtered)$sample.id %in% bad_samples), ps_filtered)
otu_table(ps_corrected) <- otu_table(adjusted_counts, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
```

## Rarefaction Curves

```         
qiime tools import \
  --input-path combat-feature-table.biom \
  --type 'FeatureTable[Frequency]' \
  --input-format BIOMV100Format \
  --output-path combat-feature-table.qza
  
  qiime tools import \
  --type 'FeatureData[Taxonomy]' \
  --input-path combat-taxonomy.tsv \
  --output-path combat-taxonomy.qza
  
  qiime tools import \
  --input-path combat_tree.nwk \
  --type 'Phylogeny[Unrooted]' \
  --output-path combatcorrected-unrooted-tree.qza
```

```         
qiime feature-table summarize \
  --i-table combat-feature-table.qza \
  --o-visualization combat-feature-table-viz.qzv
```

\~15min

```         
qiime diversity alpha-rarefaction \
  --i-table combat-feature-table.qza \
  --p-max-depth 10000 \
  --m-metadata-file combat_adjusted_meta.tsv \
  --o-visualization alpha-rarefaction.qzv
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r}
rarecurve(t(ps_corrected@otu_table@.Data), step = 1000, tidy = FALSE)
```

```{r}
test_curve <- rarecurve(t(ps_corrected@otu_table@.Data), step = 1000, tidy = TRUE)

test_curve <- test_curve %>%
  left_join(combat_adjusted_meta %>%
              select(Site = sampleid, study),
            by = "Site")
```

```{r}
ggplot(test_curve, aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = study))+
  geom_line()+
  xlim(0, 10000)

test_curve %>%
  group_by(study, Sample)%>%
  summarize(Species = mean(Species, na.rm = F),
            sd_species = sd(Species),
            n = n())


  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = Species, group = Site, color = study))+
  geom_line()+
  xlim(0, 10000)
```

## Corrected beta

```{r}
ord_bray_uncorrected <- ordinate(ps_filtered, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray", na.rm = T)
ord_bray_corrected <- ordinate(ps_corrected, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray", na.rm = T)

plot_ordination(ps_filtered, ord_bray_uncorrected, color = "study") + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggtitle("PCoA of Global Patterns (Bray-Curtis): Uncorrected Baseline Samples")

plot_ordination(ps_corrected, ord_bray_corrected, color = "study") + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggtitle("PCoA of Global Patterns (Bray-Curtis): ComBat-seq Corrected Baseline Samples")
```
